description: Fix XAUUSD ProTrader EA signal generation and filtering issues preventing trades from being taken. Lower thresholds, fix RSI scoring to be trend-following, reduce news/session filter aggressiveness, add data readiness checks, and adjust risk/cooldown defaults.
steps: Lower signal threshold from 30 to 20 and add EMA fast-path
Add InpTradeAllSessions input and bypass session filter when true
Change news filter defaults and add impact threshold
Add bars readiness check in OnInit
Add intermediate pullback scoring in GetEMAScore
acceptance_criteria: Signal threshold lowered to 20 in GenerateSignal and OnTick
EMA fast-path: if emaScore >= 60, signal generated regardless of composite
RSI scoring is trend-following based on EMA direction
InpTradeAllSessions input added defaulting to true
IsSessionAllowed returns true when InpTradeAllSessions is true
News filter only blocks events with impact >= 3
InpNewsBefore changed to 15, InpNewsAfter changed to 10
Bars readiness check in OnInit with log messages
EMA pullback scoring gives +30 for price between fast and slow in a trend
findings: All 8 signal/filter issues fixed. Braces balanced (431/431). GetRSIScore calls GetEMAScore internally for trend context but no recursion risk since GetEMAScore only reads indicator buffers. Session filter default changed from false to true for off-hours. News filter now only blocks impact >= 3 events (NFP, FOMC, CPI, GDP, Fed Speech, Core PCE). File grew from 4002 to 4094 lines.
